dialogues.speaker: Kevin
dialogues.text: Come on, you blasted beasts! Eat me if you can!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Oh no! Kevin's been caught by monsters!

dialogues.speaker: Talochard
dialogues.text: Isn't that fine, though? That's a problem child we're talking about — and any monster that eats him will inherit those problems. It'll save us some trouble, won't it?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hey! We only need to take care of the problem, alright? Who wants to take care of a kid!?
